questions.title: What does V1 session management actually do today?
questions.body: **What does V1 session management actually do today?** Walk through the full session lifecycle: creation, crash recovery, session persistence, output structure. What works reliably vs what is fragile?

questions.title: What is the current agent system capable of?
questions.body: **What is the current agent system capable of?** The 6-layer agent model, team/mode YAML definitions, prompt assembly. How much of the designed agent sophistication actually influences outputs vs being cosmetic?

questions.title: Which of the 39 proposed features are finishing V1 work vs building genuinely new systems?
questions.body: **Which of the 39 proposed features are finishing V1 work vs building genuinely new systems?** Some features like live question queueing are stubbed in V1. Others like stigmergic coordination need new subsystems. This distinction drives scoping.

questions.title: What are the load-bearing architectural constraints V2 must work within?
questions.body: **What are the load-bearing architectural constraints V2 must work within?** Where is the engine rigid vs flexible? What is cheap to extend vs expensive to rearchitect?

questions.title: What should V2 absolutely NOT try to change about V1?
questions.body: **What should V2 absolutely NOT try to change about V1?** What is working well enough that touching it would be high-risk low-reward?
